question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'** i.e.** 'Up'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sentence describes** various activities related to assembling air purifiers. In this context, the staff members at a homeless shelter in Los Angeles are setting up 20 homemade purifiers.
 
• The phrase** "setting up" **is commonly used to describe the act of assembling, arranging, or preparing something for use. In this case, it indicates that the staff members are putting together or arranging the purifiers so they can be used.
 
• The **other options** "on," "in," and "off" **do not fit** the context or make grammatical sense with the verb "setting" in this sentence.
 
• Therefore, the** correct phrase** that fits the context is "setting up," making the correct option 'up'.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'One afternoon, a dozen Arizona State University students gathered to spend the morning cutting cardboard, taping fans and assembling filters in an effort to build 125 portable air purifiers for local schools. That same morning, staff members at a homeless shelter in Los Angeles were setting **up **20 homemade purifiers of their own, while in Brookline, Massachusetts, another DIY air purifier was whirring quietly in the back of a day care (5)______ as children played.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **On** (पर) - Often used to indicate a surface, direction, or part of a physical object; doesn't fit in this context.
 
• **In **( में) - Used to indicate inclusion within space, a place, or limits; not applicable here.
 
• **Off** (बंद) - Refers to the state of being disengaged or no longer continuing; does not work with "setting" in this context.
